papers.title: Scalable Log Determinants for Gaussian Process Kernel Learning
papers.abstract: For applications as varied as Bayesian neural networks, determinantal point processes, elliptical graphical models, and kernel learning for Gaussian processes (GPs), one must compute a log determinant of an $n \times n$ positive definite matrix, and its derivatives - leading to prohibitive $\mathcal{O}(n^3)$ computations. We propose novel $\mathcal{O}(n)$ approaches to estimating these quantities from only fast matrix vector multiplications (MVMs). These stochastic approximations are based on Chebyshev, Lanczos, and surrogate models, and converge quickly even for kernel matrices that have challenging spectra. We leverage these approximations to develop a scalable Gaussian process approach to kernel learning. We find that Lanczos is generally superior to Chebyshev for kernel learning, and that a surrogate approach can be highly efficient and accurate with popular kernels.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注高斯过程核学习中对数行列式的可扩展计算，与方法学有关，但未涉及有限元代理建模或生物力学设计。
llm.why_not_core: Does not apply to finite element surrogate modeling or biomechanical design; no implant context or FEA integration.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效计算高斯过程核矩阵的对数行列式
summary_zh.method: 使用Chebyshev、Lanczos和代理模型进行随机逼近
summary_zh.result: Lanczos方法在核学习中优于Chebyshev，代理模型准确高效
summary_zh.validation: 在核学习任务上进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To compute log determinants of large positive definite matrices efficiently for Gaussian process kernel learning.
summary_en.method: Proposes O(n) stochastic approximations based on Chebyshev, Lanczos, and surrogate models using only matrix-vector multiplications.
summary_en.result: Lanczos method outperforms Chebyshev for kernel learning, and surrogate approach achieves high accuracy with popular kernels.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on kernel learning tasks demonstrate convergence and accuracy.

papers.title: Low- and high-cycle fatigue resistance of Ti-6Al-4V ELI additively manufactured via selective laser melting: Mean stress and defect sensitivity
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Industrial Engineering, University of Trento, Trento, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: M. Benedetti
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Industrial Engineering, University of Trento, Trento, Italy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V ELI的疲劳性能，对理解增材制造植入物的疲劳行为有参考价值，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡.
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure for stiffness matching, no osseointegration or surface roughness, and no direct link to biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V ELI的疲劳行为及缺陷敏感性.
summary_zh.method: 通过低周和高周疲劳实验，分析平均应力和缺陷对疲劳寿命的影响.
summary_zh.result: 缺陷和平均应力显著影响疲劳强度，高周疲劳对表面缺陷更敏感.
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验数据与理论模型对比验证.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fatigue resistance and defect sensitivity of Ti-6Al-4V ELI fabricated by selective laser melting under low- and high-cycle regimes.
summary_en.method: Fatigue tests were conducted with varying mean stresses and defect conditions to assess the influence on fatigue life.
summary_en.result: Both mean stress and internal defects critically degrade fatigue performance, with surface defects being particularly detrimental in the high-cycle fatigue regime.
summary_en.validation: Experimental results were compared with existing fatigue models and literature data for validation.

papers.title: Assessment of hydrogels for bioprinting of endothelial cells
papers.abstract: Abstract In tissue engineering applications, vascularization can be accomplished by coimplantation of tissue forming cells and endothelial cells (ECs), whereby the latter are able to form functional blood vessels. The use of three‐dimensional (3D) bioprinting technologies has the potential to improve the classical tissue engineering approach because these will allow the generation of scaffolds with high spatial control of endothelial cell allocation. This study focuses on a side by side comparison of popular commercially available bioprinting hydrogels (Matrigel, fibrin, collagen, gelatin, agarose, Pluronic F‐127, alginate, and alginate/gelatin) in the context of their physicochemical parameters, their swelling/degradation characteristics, their biological effects on vasculogenesis‐related EC parameters and their printability. The aim of this study was to identify the most suitable hydrogel or hydrogel combination for inkjet printing of ECs to build prevascularized tissue constructs. Most tested hydrogels displayed physicochemical characteristics suitable for inkjet printing. However, Pluronic F‐127 and the alginate/gelatin blend were rapidly degraded when incubated in cell culture medium. Agarose, Pluronic F‐127, alginate and alginate/gelatin hydrogels turned out to be unsuitable for bioprinting of ECs because of their non‐adherent properties and/or their incapability to support EC proliferation. Gelatin was able to support EC proliferation and viability but was unable to support endothelial cell sprouting. Our experiments revealed fibrin and collagen to be most suitable for bioprinting of ECs, because these hydrogels showed acceptable swelling/degradation characteristics, supported vasculogenesis‐related EC parameters and showed good printability. Moreover, ECs in constructs of preformed spheroids survived the printing process and formed capillary‐like cords. © 2017 Wiley Periodicals, Inc. J Biomed Mater Res Part A: 106A: 935–947, 2018.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及任何人工智能方法，完全基于实验比较生物打印用水凝胶，与AI辅助生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is purely experimental hydrogel characterization for bioprinting, with no AI/ML integration, no workflow automation, and no decision-making component.

summary_zh.motivation: 筛选最适合内皮细胞喷墨打印的水凝胶，用于构建预血管化组织工程支架。
summary_zh.method: 对比Matrigel、纤维蛋白、胶原等八种水凝胶的理化参数、降解特性、生物学效应及可打印性。
summary_zh.result: 纤维蛋白和胶原蛋白水凝胶最适合内皮细胞生物打印，支持血管生成相关参数和良好打印性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞活力、增殖、出芽实验及打印后毛细管样结构形成进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To identify the optimal hydrogel for inkjet bioprinting of endothelial cells to enable prevascularized tissue constructs.
summary_en.method: Eight commercially available hydrogels were compared side-by-side for physicochemical properties, swelling/degradation, cell viability, proliferation, sprouting, and printability.
summary_en.result: Fibrin and collagen hydrogels were most suitable, supporting endothelial cell function and forming capillary-like cords after printing.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation included cell-based assays (viability, proliferation, sprouting) and post-printing morphological assessment.

papers.title: Experimental Research on Selective Laser Melting AlSi10Mg Alloys: Process, Densification and Performance
papers.first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Manufacturing System Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, Shaanxi, China

corresponding_authors.name: Zhen Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Manufacturing System Engineering, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an, Shaanxi, China

papers.venue: Journal of Materials Engineering and Performance

llm.relevance_to_user: 关于SLM工艺参数对AlSi10Mg合金致密化和力学性能的研究，缺乏生物医学植入物相关的多孔结构、疲劳测试或骨整合评估。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design for stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface characterization for osseointegration, and the material (AlSi10Mg) is not a typical biomedical implant alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM参数对AlSi10Mg合金致密化和性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率和扫描速度，分析致密度和力学性能
summary_zh.result: 优化工艺参数可获得高致密度和良好力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试致密度、硬度和拉伸强度验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of selective laser melting parameters on the densification and mechanical properties of AlSi10Mg alloy.
summary_en.method: Systematically varying laser power and scanning speed to fabricate specimens, followed by density measurement, microstructure observation, and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Optimized process parameters yield nearly fully dense parts with improved tensile strength and hardness.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization of density, hardness, and tensile properties validates the process-property relationships.
